contact.name: Ada Quinn
contact.personality: Practical about losses, appreciative of accurate work, unimpressed by dramatic guesses.
contact.need: An accurate alarm inspection and safe daylight reopening.
contact.knowledge: Her shop, work commissioned by her, and information actually delivered to her.

causes.break_in: A forced latch and missing stock confirm a break-in; no offender has been identified.
causes.faulty_alarm: A damaged alarm contact triggered the bell; there is no evidence of entry.
causes.delivery_error: An authorized delivery used the wrong entrance and triggered the alarm; no offender has been identified.

offer.title: The Night Shift: daylight help
offer.situation: Ada offers $12 for a complete inspection, $6 for incomplete observations, $0 if no useful work is delivered. The first evidence day permits a complete inspection, the next only partial work, and the last no useful inspection. A separate unpaid safety check can help the shop instead. Accepting is a real commitment; ignoring an unknown notice is not.
offer.speaker: Ada Quinn

options.label: Accept the inspection agreement
options.tradeoff: One action now and one to inspect. Deadlines and reduced pay are disclosed; uncompleted commitments affect Ada's trust.

options.label: Help secure the shop lawfully
options.tradeoff: No immediate wage; reduces disruption and earns a safety-work reference.

options.label: Refuse involvement
options.tradeoff: No promise, payment, trust loss or forced follow-up.

work.title: Inspect the alarm evidence
work.situation: Only actual observations can establish a cause. Complete work pays $12; partial observations pay $6; no useful evidence pays $0. The independent shop review proceeds regardless.
work.speaker: Ada Quinn

options.label: Attempt the agreed inspection
options.tradeoff: Evidence is complete on its first day, partial on its second, gone on its third. Findings are delivered to Ada; no offender is inferred.

report.title: Choose who receives the observations
report.situation: You may submit your actual findings to the Civic Police public incident desk, or lawfully keep them between yourself and the owner. Neither choice creates a player crime or promises a prosecution.
report.speaker: Your incident journal

options.label: Submit an accurate scoped statement
options.tradeoff: The desk receives only what you observed and acknowledges the submission to Ada. A later statement-review opportunity may open.

options.label: Withhold the optional statement lawfully
options.tradeoff: No police disclosure, legal penalty or guilt; a complete private inspection can still earn a shop reference.

followup.title: A reference changes tomorrow's work
followup.situation: Your recorded contribution opened one funded $8 daylight follow-up: safety preparation, private shop records, or a scoped statement review. This is not membership or private-case access.
followup.speaker: Ada Quinn

options.label: Complete the offered follow-up
options.tradeoff: One action, one $8 payment, one reference; cannot repeat or reopen this incident.
